instagram.body:
Instagram's algorithm has a favourite type of video and I'm about to tell you what it looks like 👇✨
Okay, so Instagram's algorithm has a favorite type of video and once you know about the structure, your whole content life changes. Are you ready? So, hi everyone, this is Ally and I am a 24-year-old social media manager at New Project Production house. And as what I'm saying, Instagram's algorithm has a favorite type of video, and let me walk you through it. Hook in second one, not in second three, not after your cute little intro music babe. The Instagram's algorithm drop off from frame one. Start late and you're already losing gorgeous. Pattern interrupt at the 7 second mark, a cut, a sound effect, a text pop, something that resets attention. That is why fast edits outperforms the slow ones. Science and aesthetics working together, we love that one. And with a question or a cliffhanger, comments and saves tells the algorithm that this video has a value. And the longer the people stay and comment, the more the algorithm falls in love with your content. We build every video around platform psychology and not just pretty visual darling. DM platform and let's make the algorithm obsessed with your content.

tiktok.body:
I’m in pre-launch, scheduled to ship mid-late 2026. The app will be available in the U.S only. Link in bio for waitlist signup and full details. Stay on track with your admin while building client trust in the same app 🤝 myparlorhq.com #freelancer #selfemployed #freelancerlife #contractor #taxes
I think I may have created the best all in one tool for freelancers. Imagine having one app that lets you operate both sides of your freelance business. The side your client sees and the side you're used to operating on the back end with all the tax write offs and admin stuff. What if I told you this app lets your client see your company logo when filling out contracts, viewing past invoices, making payments, or getting automated payment reminders. Essentially it white labels the app so you clients never see the actual app name anywhere on their screen. What if I told you this app lets you take a snapshot of your receipt and categorize it in under 30 seconds using AI Imagine if that same app let you track your time per client and gave you a profitability report right on your dashboard so you know exactly which clients are worth your time and which ones aren't. All that and more for less than the price of a fast food meal per month. Oh, something I forgot to mention. The app lets you personalise your experience based off of your trade. So if you are a plumber, contractor, photographer, yoga instructor, your tax write offs and business jargon will all be tailored toward your trade. Check out the website at myparlorhq.com The first 50 people on the wait list lock in founding member pricing at $9 per month for life. I love feedback so If you have any at all after viewing the website, please let me know.
